notes: v654 - the LESSONS are brought up to date. Several were still teaching preset numbers the app stopped using: Defender was described as 12/6, All-rounder as 20/8 and Hunter as 30/10, none of which had been true since the presets were rebuilt from testing. Lesson 11 and lesson 38 now carry the real ones - Defender 15/15 on $0.20-$0.99, All-rounder 20/15 on $0.15-$1.75, and Hunter with NO take-profit and no fixed stop at all, just a 20% trailing stop. Lesson 14 recommended a starter kit combining a tight trail with a fixed target; it now gives both that cautious kit and the tested one, and says plainly which measured better and why. Two new steps in lesson 11 cover Today's picks - what it is, how the Practice buy button works, why an empty day is normal - and why the price band is $0.20-$0.99, including that the band is the weakest part of the evidence rather than a proven number. Nothing in the app's behaviour changed; only what it teaches. Practice money only. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
